decisions.reason: Submarine interior lighting is a multi-model line that took heavy specialized investment and certification and serves long naval programs, so management will justify persisting despite its distance from the core and its thin web presence.

Explosion-proof luminaires are a certified multi-model line building on core competence, with ongoing visible investment such as the LED replacement kit, so dropping it would write off substantial commitment.

The designer task light was publicly relaunched as a popular product and remains close to the core, so the firm is likely to keep it to justify the relaunch, though a single older model carries some risk of being dropped.
This single pendant office luminaire is close to the core and was presented on its own page, so with little to justify it is somewhat vulnerable, but it is cheap to keep within the office range.
The premium pendant line has several models and fits the energy-efficient LED direction the firm has announced, so its investment and visible commitment favor keeping it.
